name: fmp_crypto_list
description:
Cryptocurrencies covered by Financial Modeling Prep (FMP), with their symbols.
Returns {tool, endpoint, data}: data is FMP's JSON from /stable/cryptocurrency-list as returned (usually a list of records).
Inputs (* required): none.
Use the symbols with fmp_crypto_quote or fmp_crypto_historical.
Example: {}
